generation.headline: Metro Kings Edge Waves 101-98 to Even the Finals at 1-1
generation.summary: The Metro Kings beat the Harbour City Waves 101-98 in Game 2 of the Championship Finals, levelling the series at 1-1. Malik Grant led the Kings with 28 points and eight rebounds.
generation.why_fans_will_care: The Finals are now a fresh best-of series after a tight three-point result, and Malik Grant's 28-point, eight-rebound performance gives Kings fans a standout storyline heading into the next game.
